{{Quote|This creature means no harm. It's just frightened and confused. It doesn't know where it is, or why we are here.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="YJK: HotF" />}}
A '''monster''' [[Species/Legends|species]] inhabited the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was large, with shaggy [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]], and hunted in the jungle. In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], one creature attacked the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Peckhum]] outside the [[Jedi Praxeum]] but was sent back into the jungle by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

==Biology and appearance==
The [[Species/Legends|species]] had a triangular head on a squarish body with shaggy [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. Twelve [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] covered its face, with each ending in an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] with a slitted pupil. It had long and sharp [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]] in its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], was as large as a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and had six large legs.<ref name="YJK: HotF" />

==Behavior==
The species sought out [[Diet/Legends|prey]] in the jungles of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], which it inhabited. When angered or startled, the monster would let out a loud, high-pitched trumpet sound.<ref name="YJK: HotF" />

==History==
{{Quote|Last time we saw you, Peckhum, you were cornered by a jungle monster on Yavin.|Jaina Solo|<ref name="YJK: TLO">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>}}
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Peckhum]] landed his supply [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Lightning Rod]]'', on Yavin 4 during one of his supply runs to the [[Jedi Praxeum]] and was attacked by one such monster. He grabbed his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in order to defend himself, but [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] realized that the monster was not attacking him but was simply confused, and he [[Telekinesis/Legends|flung]] Peckhum's weapon from his hands. After Skywalker calmed the monster, to the amazement of his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] students [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], as well as Peckhum, the monster ran back into the jungle to seek out different prey.<ref name="YJK: HotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The monster first appeared in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]'', which was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], and released in [[1995]].<ref name="YJK: HotF" />
